title: BIG BALL BREAK
oneLiner: Smash every brick with a giant bouncing ball before it overwhelms the screen!
mechanics: Slide the paddle left and right to keep the huge ball in play.
The ball breaks bricks on contact and rebounds off walls and the paddle.
Clear bricks to score, with tougher brick patterns appearing as you advance.
The ball speeds up over time, making misses harder to recover from.

controls.a: Launch the ball or serve again

lose: Lose a life when the ball falls below the paddle; the game ends after the last life.
scoring: Earn points for every brick smashed, with bonus points for clearing a row.
